__comment: Storage Shelf - eight visible item slots, four per level; capacity equals anchor count.
Ground shelf, open on all sides. Oak/iron redesign authorized by Alen (art doc 41, 2026-10-01).
The new authored generator replaces the previous hand-authoring reservation.
Anchors use footprint-local block coordinates, origin bottom-front-left.
Shelf surfaces stay at Y 0.125 and 1.0; 1x1 footprint and 2-block collision are unchanged.
anchor_scale 0.5 is the maximum. anchor_max_size fits each rotated item into its clear slot;
visible bounds are centered horizontally and bottom-aligned to prevent overlap or floating.
description: An open oak rack with iron corner fittings and two plank shelves. Eight stored items remain visible.
